result.rationale: Candidate A has a critical issue: it prepends 'SHALL means mandatory.' into the REWRITE field. The task says the rewrite should preserve the SHALL response obligation but treat the keyword declaration itself as a preamble/convention note, not as body text to reproduce verbatim in the rewritten contract. Including it inside REWRITE violates the instruction to rewrite the contract (not copy the convention declaration into it), and it also risks converting the convention statement into an obligation. Candidate B correctly omits the keyword convention line from the REWRITE body, producing only the two operative sentences: the SHALL obligation and the descriptive nonce-copy fact without any obligation keyword added. Both candidates correctly use engineering-default, preserve gateway/request/nonce/header roles, and add no obligation keyword to the nonce-copy statement, but A's inclusion of the keyword declaration inside REWRITE is a consequential violation of the task framing.
